dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Taking proper breaks between challenges helps you better face your next hurdle. Whoever designed this challenge clearly put a lot of thought into it.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: This place is a picture-perfect for a tea party. Pretty relaxing, I'd say.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: But you know, I've always wanted to suggest we do something other than sip tea. I mean, you can party just fine with wine. Good thing I brought my own drinks...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: When facing a foe who's hard to beat, I find it best to make a plan, devise a strategy.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...Hmm? Do I look like someone who would just charge straight at the enemy, swinging my sword?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Haha, when I'm alone, that's one thing, but when I have companions by my side, I have to consider everyone's safety.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: This place feels... a little like the Ley Lines.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: That said, did these books come from? Couldn't have come from our library, could they?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Heh... Clearly the mages' handiwork — never ceases to impress, no matter how many times I see it.
